conversion_parameters.speaker_embeddings: Raw OpenVoice embeddings; source is the arithmetic mean of five windows, target is the exact saved reference. No voice-profile assets were changed.

speaker_comparison.method: Independent WeSpeaker embeddings compared with the approved reference, used as a qualitative voice-consistency check. These scores are not a match percentage or identity guarantee.

speech_content_preservation.method: The original Tamil waveform, including all utterances, is supplied directly to the voice converter. Every input sample interval is represented in the output at its original position. Only the voice timbre is converted; there is no transcription-driven resynthesis, translation, reordering, manual pitch effect or speed change.
speech_content_preservation.recognition_limitations: Native Tamil Whisper transcriptions were unreliable on this colloquial recording, with truncation and repetition, and are not used as proof of exact words. Full-length independent NeMo CTC phonetic comparisons were reviewed across all 24 converted chunks. The recognizer is trained for English: its approximate Latin transcriptions are a relative clarity check, not an authoritative Tamil transcript. Character alignment ratios are diagnostic, not word accuracy or voice match percentages.
